status_definitions.OPEN: Public source with affirmative availability evidence; counts only when qualifies_per_arm is true.
status_definitions.NOT_OPEN: Identified source lacks demonstrated open access/licence, or access is blocked. This does not assert that it is paywalled.
status_definitions.NOT_FOUND: No matching trial source established within the stated checks; not a universal absence claim.

method.scope: All QUALIFIES records, registry trial IDs unchanged; six requested source families (EMA split into EPAR and clinical-data portal).
method.forecast_rule: Count each distinct trial once if at least one OPEN source has qualifies_per_arm=true.
method.open_licences: CC BY, CC0, and other explicitly recorded Creative Commons licences, including CC BY-NC-ND, are accepted for this reachability forecast. Restrictions remain applicable; no non-CC-BY article prose is reproduced.
method.eligibility: CT.gov hasResults=true; reachable EU results page; trial-matched EMA/HC CSR; FDA review with trial-specific arm-level results; or reachable openly licensed whole-trial results paper. An EPAR mention, drug listing, abstract, DOI redirect, or licence alone is insufficient.
method.adapters: Inspected scripts/g1_trial_acquire.py and scripts/g1_regulatory_source.py. Used direct HTTP to avoid adapter caches/model calls outside .codex_logs; FDA application-doc/TOC discovery follows existing adapter strategy, with current pdfFilenames JavaScript metadata support.
method.politeness: Sequential HTTP with 0.7-0.8 second delays, finite request timeouts, bounded fallbacks.
method.dates: Live metadata checked at recorded UTC timestamps; no trial study dates or numerical outcome estimates inferred.

hardcode_disclosure.basis: Task policy; publication IDs manually selected from saved live metadata and linked CT.gov references.

hardcode_disclosure.item: Candidate/trial set, availability, licences, URLs, hashes, forecast numerator
hardcode_disclosure.basis: Registry file and live HTTP/API evidence; numerator derived from source flags.

limitations: Reachability is environment- and time-dependent. NOT_FOUND/NOT_OPEN with an access error is unresolved, not proof of absence.
Follow-up reports can support a trial-level forecast without reproducing the meta-analysis timepoint or outcome.
No per-arm effects, participant counts, or other statistical results were extracted or validated.
Health Canada live portal requests failed TLS validation and web retrieval timed out. Indexed official portal metadata lists DARZALEX (submission 187648); no trial-matched CSR was verified.
